title: English Civil War
summary: A series of wars between King Charles I and Parliament over how England, Scotland and Ireland should be governed. Generally held to have begun when the king raised his standard at Nottingham on 22 August 1642; Parliament's side won the first war in 1646, and the fighting ended at Worcester on 3 September 1651.

uncertainty.note: Start is conventionally 22 August 1642 (Nottingham); the National Army Museum gives the wider British Civil Wars as 1642-51.

where.modern_name: Nottingham, England (proxy pin: city centre, where the war is held to have begun)

importance.justification: Conflict between Crown and Parliament that shaped later British government; the museum source says monarchs were never again supreme.
